snippet.title: Tied to the Beat - 15 Minutes of Gameplay - Violinist (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
15 minutes of Tied to the Beat with the Violinist. You upload any song and its lyrics become the enemies and bullets you fight, so every run plays to a different track.

Out July 31, 2026. Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/4316340
